charter-oak--charter-oak-ct-shade.description: One of the two original Charter Oak blends from Foundation Cigar Co., this cigar pairs a Connecticut Shade wrapper with a Sumatra binder and Nicaraguan filler from Jalapa and Estelí. It smokes smooth and creamy, with nuts and cedar at the core and a little more Nicaraguan pepper than a typical Connecticut; an easy daytime choice.

thirds.notes: Smooth nuttiness and cream with cedar behind, plus white pepper and a touch of cinnamon through the nose.
Nuts and cream remain and the sweetness grows; cedar steps back, faint cinnamon lingers and a slight bitter edge appears.
Cedar strengthens around the nutty core and a little pepper returns on a fairly short finish.

charter-oak--charter-oak-habano.description: Added to Foundation Cigar Co.'s Charter Oak line in September 2020, the Habano uses an Ecuadorian Habano wrapper over Nicaraguan binder and filler, rolled at A.J. Fernandez in Estelí. Toasty and nutty, it brings pecan, mocha and leather, with black pepper and baking spice that gather strength toward the end.

thirds.notes: Toasted, bready notes with a little leather and raisin sweetness; pecan, cinnamon and black pepper on the retrohale.
Pecans take over with mocha behind, black pepper and a tangy leather finish build, and a brief citrus note fades.
Mocha comes forward with pecan and cashew as leather and pepper return over a dry, earthy, grainy base.

charter-oak--charter-oak-ct-broadleaf.description: Foundation Cigar Co.'s Charter Oak Broadleaf, one of the line's two original blends, sets a dark Connecticut Broadleaf wrapper on a Nicaraguan Habano binder and Nicaraguan filler from Estelí and Jalapa. Medium in strength, it is earthy and nutty, with dark chocolate, espresso, leather and cedar over a peppery, slightly tannic edge.

thirds.notes: Earth and semi-sweet chocolate with roasted nuts, cedar and leather, and black pepper strongest on the nose.
Nuttier, with espresso coming forward, leather and earth underneath and a hint of dried fruit.
Charred cedar and toasted nuts with pepper and loamy earth; chocolate and espresso trade places to a long, dry finish.
